title: Traffic Light Weekly: Serving Brief (Rahul)
body:
Purpose: lightweight weekly sync oriented around a simple traffic-light snapshot so we can spot regressions early and prioritize immediate follow-ups.

How to use this doc: pull the traffic-light row before the meeting, paste into standup, annotate in-line with owners. Keep notes terse — two-line max per item. If something needs a long discussion, create a follow-up thread/epic.

Traffic-light snapshot (pre-meeting notes):
- runtime-serving: GREEN — p99 latency stable at 210ms, small GC spike on green nodes last night but autoscaler recovered.
- batcher/throughput: YELLOW — batching efficiency dropped ~7% for short prompts after client change; suspect new SDK default of `max_tokens_per_batch`.
- kv-cache: RED (intermittent) — write latency increased during 03:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window; hit cache-thundering on a small subset of customers.
- model-routing: GREEN — canary at 10% looks good, no quality regressions.
- console/dashboard: YELLOW — trace sampling misaligned with user requests, missing token-level cost breakdown on one route.

Rapid log lines to grab before meeting:
1) controller-logs@2026-03-12: "batcher: reduced full batches by 8% after sdk v1.14"
2) kvproxy@03:15 UTC: "timeout while writing cache shard s-17"
3) dashboard: missing tokens route /api/v1/usage?route=chat-stream

Hypothesis/next-step ideas:
- Batcher drop: try toggling `max_tokens_per_batch` client-side to previous default for a subset of traffic; measure change over 1 hour. (Omar)
- KV cache: add temporary request coalescing on shard s-17 and raise write timeout to 6s; open an incident ticket if we see >3 errors/min. (Tess)
- Dashboard traces: re-run sampling job for the last 48h; ensure telemetry pipeline didn't drop spans during rollback window. (Priya)

Notes from last week (follow-ups):
- PR #1826 (controller backpressure): merged, in staging. Need canary plan for prod rollout.
- Runbook draft for "kv write latency" still WIP (section on TTL trimming).

Meeting rules for this squad:
- Keep the traffic-light status honest; err on caution.
- Action items should be SMART and owned.
- If an issue is red and affects >1 customer, swap into ad-hoc incident channel and pivot meeting into incident review.
action_items: Omar — revert client `max_tokens_per_batch` default for the 2-highest-volume customers; measure batch efficiency by 2026-03-13 — in progress
Tess — implement temporary request coalescing and increase kv write timeout to 6s on shard s-17; monitor error rate and post results by 2026-03-12 — follow-up needed
Priya — re-run trace sampling backfill for routes missing token-level cost breakdown and confirm dashboard shows data by 2026-03-14 — blocked on infra quota
Rahul — draft a short canary rollout plan for PR #1826 and propose rollout window (2am-4am UTC) by 2026-03-13 — ready for review
